text: Confirmed and filed #6585: VFP9 `RENAME source.bin TO renamed.bin` moves a four-byte binary fixture (embedded NUL included); Copperfin reports runtime error and leaves the source/no destination. Quoted control succeeds. VFP9 SP2 reference documents RENAME FileName1 TO FileName2 and wildcard names. The runtime host is a few minutes older than HEAD; intervening dispatch change only touched SET FILTER, and current RENAME parser/handler are unchanged. Issue open, owner-authored, labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved; no product edits.
